response.overview: David finds out about the illicit relationship between his wife Bincy and Mathew, a local toddy shop owner and threatens to kill Mathew. Couple of days later, the Dead body of Mathew is found on the banks of Thannithode river and Bincy identifies the body. Akhil Nandakumar newly appointed sub-inspector is inspecting the case who has a rivalry with David. Now with Mathew’s body being found on the riverbank, David is on the run and police are in search of him. Akhil sets up a plan to arrest David from his hideout to regain his lost dignity which ends up complicating and questioning his existence among his peers.
response.title: ADAR
